about:
I-Chips Technology Inc. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in San Jose, California. The company operates as a fabless semiconductor supplier specializing in video-processing LSI and FPGA-based board products. No founders or ownership details are disclosed in the available sources.

The product line centers on image-processing LSI devices: scaler, de-interlacer/scaler, cross-point switch, and warping/edge-blending chips, several with integrated memory for 4K and 8K resolutions. Recent releases include the IP00C335 4K multi-input/output de-interlacer/scaler with built-in memory, the IP00C241 memory-less scaler for 4K60Hz, the IP00C251 3×3 cross-point switch for 4K60Hz, and the iEB-KXU2 FPGA board supporting HDMI 4K60Hz input and output. The company also offers FPGA boards for prototyping and integration.

I-Chips targets the broadcast and professional AV markets, as evidenced by its demonstration of the IP00C335 at the 2026 NAB Show on the Macnica Americas booth. Its components are designed for OEMs and system integrators building 4K/8K video walls, projection mapping, and real-time video conversion equipment.

The company has not publicly stated a founding mission or specific competitive differentiators beyond its product specifications.
